notes.title: Seductive Shadows V.0.5.5 Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837771/9f96f03d38292e10c4a3c21419e37f774b8fd739.gif"]

Hey everyone!

A new version of Seductive Shadows, V.0.5.5, is now live on Steam! This update brings a wave of fresh scenes, emotional tension, and plenty of heat! Whether you're here for the drama or the desire, there’s something waiting for you!

🔥 What’s Inside V.0.5.5

Major Story Update
With over 65,000 new words of content (around 3.5 hours of gameplay), this update takes you deeper into steamy relationships, confrontations, and important choices that may shift everything going forward.

New Hookup Options
Two new characters make their debut, purely as hookup options. These are not major story characters and won’t be involved in the central plot. They’re here for one thing only: to give the MC some extra opportunities to let off steam. More hookup-only characters will be introduced in future updates, designed for quick, hot encounters without long-term storylines.

NSFW CGs
Unlock 19–20 brand-new explicit CGs, covering a range of scenes across multiple routes. From intense to intimate, each one adds new heat to the choices you make.

⚠️ Notes & Fixes
Minor bug fixes and touch-ups have been made to improve the overall experience.



Your support means everything, whether you’re leaving a review, sharing your favorite scenes, or just following the ride. This project thrives thanks to players like you.

Let me know what you think of the new content on our Official Discord Server, and stay tuned. Things are only going to get steamier from here!

Chysa

notes.title: Update Notes - Version [0.4.5]
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I’ve received a few reports about some bugs in the release version of the game, and I’m happy to share that these issues have been fixed. See the full list of changes below:

Bug Fixes:


 Sally Censor Bug (Gay Path): Corrected an issue where Sally's appearance or dialogue was censored incorrectly during the gay romance path.
 "Chen Not Defined" Error: Fixed a scripting error that caused crashes when Chen was referenced in certain scenes.
 Clara Mentioned Inconsistently: Clara was not mentioned during the texting conversation between MC and August but appeared later in MC's dialogue, fixed the conditions to make that bit of text appear.


If you encounter any other bugs or issues, feel free to report them! The best place to do so is on the Seductive Shadows Discord Server.

Thank you for playing Seductive Shadows! If you’re enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review on our Steam Page, it really helps boost the game’s visibility and reach!

CHYSA GAMES
